Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer prematurely identified “I Know What You Did Last Summer” as the 1997 American mystery crime film “starring” Johnny Galecki without verification. This misidentification ignored the visible SERP evidence highlighting “Suicide Kings” (1997), an American crime thriller/black comedy explicitly listing Johnny Galecki among the main cast. Additionally, Galecki is not a star of “I Know What You Did Last Summer,” and that film is primarily a slasher rather than a crime film. The error stems from failing to cross-check credible sources (e.g., IMDb/Wikipedia) and conflating genre and billing details.
